essence: The bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names the treasury: lights of knowing, triumphed by woe-averting Śaṃbhura.
Vyāsa-lineage, hundreds-of-thousands measure, mokṣa-as-fruit: the Gītārthasaṃgraha's prāmāṇya is claimed here [one LIVE fork, grounds in L0].
Liberation named: complete-differentiation-form, all-knowing, need-free, ever-risen in Bhagavān — laya, this much, in summary [one LIVE fork].
Other texts sing mokṣa incidentally; the Bhagavadgītā gives true attainment.
Many earlier expositions; this attempt reasonable — revealing the hidden meaning.
Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's tradition, long-examined, made by Abhinavagupta: the name declared.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)
rasa.justification: The verses wonder their own contents — what is stored, by what authority, named how — then settle into signature; relish is self-declaration, not argument.

sections.FUNCTION: Opens the work with a six-verse mangala: invocation, prāmāṇya-claim, mokṣa-definition, Gītā-supremacy, exculpation-of-effort, and the signed colophon.
sections.KEY TERMS: bhāva-cakra (diverse-state wheel as the text's own image); bodha-bhāsā (lights of knowing); prāmāṇya (authority claim); saṃskāra-svabhāva (complete-differentiation form); gūḍhārtha-prakāśaka (hidden-meaning revealer); āmnāya (oral tradition from Bhaṭṭendurāja).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The six benedictory verses precede adhyāya 1; they set the work's voice (colophon-as-verse) and its authority-claim before any Gītā commentary begins.
sections.BOUNDARY: Five L0 forks held open (mādhānyataḥ prime) — honest gaps pending Supersite/Sharma collation; no emendation smuggled into the song.
sections.EXPLANATION: The mangala works in six moves: what the work stores (knowing-lights), why it may speak (Vyāsa-lineage + measure + fruit), what mokṣa is (compounds → laya), why this text above others (samyak-prāpti), why another effort at all (gūḍhārtha), and who made it (āmnāya + name). The corrupted-print tokens stay forked — the claims they carry (authority, summary, treasury) do not depend on resolving them.
sections.RELATED: Sharma 1983 (English translation, emendations) + Gita Supersite (IIT Kanpur) as future collation/witness; Ingalls preface on print corruption; qa NEEDS_WITNESS until Sharma quoted.
